query.statement: SELECT UI_ID, TITLE, DEFINITION_JSON FROM SYS_SCREEN_DEFINITION WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE UI_ID = @uiId
SELECT UI_ID, TITLE FROM SYS_SCREEN_DEFINITION WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY UI_ID

MERGE SYS_SCREEN_DEFINITION WITH (HOLDLOCK) AS t USING (SELECT @uiId AS UI_ID) AS s ON t.UI_ID = s.UI_ID WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET TITLE = @title, DEFINITION_JSON = @definitionJson, UPDATED_BY = @currentUser, UPDATED_AT = @utcNow WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (UI_ID, TITLE, DEFINITION_JSON, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@uiId, @title, @definitionJson, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow);
SELECT ROLE_ID, ROLE_NAME, DESCRIPTION, PERMISSIONS FROM SYS_ROLE WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY ROLE_ID
SELECT ROLE_ID, ROLE_NAME, DESCRIPTION, PERMISSIONS FROM SYS_ROLE WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ROLE_ID = @roleId AND IS_DELETED = 0

SELECT MENU_ID, MENU_NAME, PARENT_MENU_ID, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, MENU_TYPE, PROGRAM_ID, IMAGE_ID, OPTIONS, UI_ID FROM SYS_MENU WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE VALID_STATE = 'Valid' ORDER BY PARENT_MENU_ID, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, MENU_TYPE, MENU_ID
SELECT USER_ID, USER_NAME, EMAIL, ROLE_ID, LANGUAGE, IS_ACTIVE, LAST_LOGIN_AT FROM SYS_USER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND (@roleId IS NULL OR ROLE_ID = @roleId) ORDER BY USER_ID
SELECT MENU_ID, MENU_NAME, PARENT_MENU_ID, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, MENU_TYPE, UI_ID FROM SYS_MENU WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE VALID_STATE = 'Valid' ORDER BY PARENT_MENU_ID, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, MENU_ID

MERGE SYS_MENU WITH (HOLDLOCK) AS t USING (SELECT @menuId AS MENU_ID) AS s ON t.MENU_ID = s.MENU_ID WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET MENU_NAME = @menuName, PARENT_MENU_ID = @parentMenuId, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE = @displaySequence, MENU_TYPE = @menuType, UI_ID = @uiId, VALID_STATE = 'Valid' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (MENU_ID, MENU_NAME, PARENT_MENU_ID, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, MENU_TYPE, UI_ID, VALID_STATE) VALUES (@menuId, @menuName, @parentMenuId, @displaySequence, @menuType, @uiId, 'Valid');
UPDATE SYS_MENU SET VALID_STATE = 'Invalid' WHERE MENU_ID = @menuId
